hook.say: One US state against a whole country. Which has more people? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which has more people: Florida or the Netherlands?
questions.sayAnswer: Florida! It has about twenty-three and a half million people. The Netherlands has about eighteen and a half million.

questions.q: Which has more people: California or Spain?
questions.fact: Spain: about 48 million people (2026). California: about 39 million (2025).
questions.sayAnswer: Spain! It has about forty-eight million people. California has about thirty-nine million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Sweden or Pennsylvania?
questions.sayAnswer: Pennsylvania! It has about thirteen million people. Sweden has fewer than eleven million.

questions.q: Which Georgia has more people: the US state or the country?
questions.say: Which Georgia has more people: the U S state, or the country?
questions.fact: The US state has 11.3 million people (2025), about 3 times the country.
questions.sayAnswer: The U S state! It has more than eleven million people, about three times as many as the country.

questions.q: Which has more people: Australia or Texas?
questions.fact: Texas: 31.7 million people (2025). All of Australia: 27.2 million (2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Texas! It has almost thirty-two million people. The whole of Australia has about twenty-seven million.
